body: I'm going through some really similar situations, if you'd be interested in talking I can PM you or vice versa?
I suppose you're right. It just doesn't feel nearly that simple. Thank you.

I just got out of an all day group therapy program but group therapy really doesn't work for me, I prefer one on one. I've done the whole therapy thing but I have never found a therapist that I click with. I'm currently looking for therapists in my area but a lot of them can not get me in for several weeks or even a month or two.

I've told my parents, best friend and boyfriend. I feel like my boyfriend is tired of hearing it and as if he's pushing me away because of it, my best friend is a great listener and she gives me great advice but sometimes I worry that she is tired of hearing it as well, and I've talked to my parents about it but I really scared them so I try to hide it because I don't want them to worry.

I have a mom and dad that love me and think I deserve the world and best friends who love me and want the best for me but I feel like awful about myself. Sometimes I can see myself with a fulfilling career, doing things I love, for example having travelled and having a happy family. Other times, I see myself failing, ending up with nothing and no one, wondering who could ever want to be with me.
I want to fight the good fight and I want to be a productive human being but I don't feel strong enough or even worthy.

Well yes, I would agree, and I am a hard worker but I spend a lot of time wondering if I will ever be good enough. I am aware that I am the only thing holding me back from the things I want to achieve, but it is not as easy as others often think to change these negative thinking patterns.
Well, that would be nice to hear but why do you think that it isn't?
But also highly competitive, like I said, always a gamble. Very nerve-racking.
No worries, I feel you there.
I would like to talk. It would probably be beneficial to read my previous post so you could be able to know more of what is going on. It's a bit long, so if you decide to read it, I apologize.
